content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is strong, but the whole-page capture shows a sticky header overlapping the hero mid-page and the page ends with three stacked contact blocks (yellow CTA, Obiščite nas, footer) repeating address, hours and phone.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero with the number-plate phone is distinctive, but the sticky header overlaps the headline in the whole-page view, the right half of every section below the hero is empty, and the contact details repeat three times at the bottom.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Merge the yellow 'Pokličite nas' block, 'Obiščite nas' and the footer into one contact section; address, hours and phone currently appear three times on both viewports.","On desktop, use the empty right column: put a workshop or team photo beside '2012', the services list and the process steps instead of leaving half the width blank.","Fix the sticky header so it stops drawing over the hero headline when scrolled, and trim the oversized '2012' numeral on phone so it doesn't dominate a section with no imagery."],"blockers":["Desktop and phone: the sticky header overlaps and hides part of the hero headline 'SAMO AUDI, BMW' in the scrolled whole-page view.","Phone and desktop bottom: address, opening hours and phone number are repeated in three consecutive blocks (yellow CTA, 'Obiščite nas', footer).","Phone first screen: hero headline 'SAMO AUDI, BMW,' sits over light ceiling area of the photo with marginal contrast."]}
